claims.text: Capers are the unopened flower buds of the caper bush, Capparis spinosa.
Capers are not berries, seeds or leaf tips; caperberries, the plant's fruit, are a separate product.
Capers are picked by hand before the buds open and are cured in salt, brine or vinegar.
If left on the plant, caper buds flower and develop into caperberries, the fruit.
